integrity: The exact orbit identity is proved from Fraïssé universality/homogeneity; the asymptotic step is explicitly delegated to the classical Erdős–Kleitman–Rothschild and Turán theorems. Small cases and the inversion identity were replayed independently by finite enumeration and exact arithmetic.
limitations: The parameter-recovery observation is a short synthesis of standard structural and enumerative results, so an unindexed folklore antecedent remains possible. The claim is restricted to generic ordered expansions and the leading quadratic entropy term.
title: Forbidden-clique parameter from tuple-orbit entropy of generically ordered Henson graphs
